The '''Scrap Ridge''' was a stone cliff located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Separated from the nearby [[Red Cliff]] by a rock formation, the Scrap Ridge was located south of [[the Wound]], and an [[Imperial Reclamation Service|Reclamation Service]] [[Abandoned Reclamation Service base|base]] was located atop the ridge.<ref name="TOR:RP" />
